questions.question: What is the main difference between a struct and a class?
questions.shortAnswer: A struct is a value type, while a class is a reference type. Struct assignment copies the value; class assignment copies the reference.

questions.question: Why are structs usually recommended to be immutable?
questions.shortAnswer: Because structs are copied by value.

answerFrom.section: ### 12. Why are structs usually recommended to be immutable?

pitfalls: Mutable structs can lead to accidental modifications of a copy rather than the original value, especially when returned from properties or collections.
